name: Should I paint or wallpaper my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Should I paint or wallpaper my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between paint and wallpaper for a bathroom depends on your aesthetic preference and functional priorities. Paint is generally more cost-effective, easier to apply, and simpler to change or touch up. Modern paints also offer excellent moisture and mildew resistance. Wallpaper can offer unique textures and patterns but can be more challenging to install and remove. In high-humidity bathrooms, certain types of wallpaper may peel over time if not installed correctly or if the room lacks proper ventilation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Paint is often more cost-effective and easier to maintain in bathrooms; wallpaper offers unique aesthetics but can be challenging with moisture.
